Profit = Revenue - Cost

Profit after tax for any year = Profit for that year - Tax for that year

Tax for any year = Tax rate for that year x Profit for that year

Find the total sum (in Rs. lakhs) of profit after tax for 2015 to 2020.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Profit after tax for 2015 

Profit for 2015 = (revenue - cost ) = (62 - 30) = 32 

Tax for 2015 = (tax rate × profit) = ( 15% × 32) = 4.8 

Hence, profit after tax for 2015 = ( profit for 2015 - tax for 2015)

⇒ (32 - 4.8) = 27.2

Profit after tax for 2016

Profit for 2016 = (75 - 35) = 40

tax for 2016 = (10% × 40) = 4

Hence, profit after tax for 2016 = (40 - 4) = 36

Profit after tax for 2017

Profit for 2017 = (84 -38) = 46

tax for 2017 = (15% × 46) = 6.9

Hence, profit after tax for 2017 = (46 -6.9) = 39.1

Profit after tax 2018

Profit for 2018 = (86- 40) = 46

tax for 2018 = (20% × 46) = 9.2

Hence, profit after tax for 2018 = (46 -9.2) = 36.8

Profit after tax for 2019

Profit for 2019 = (90 -45) = 45

tax for 2019 = (25% × 45) = 11.25)

Hence, profit after tax for 2019 = (45 -11.25) = 33.75

Profit after tax for 2020

Profit for 2020 = (95- 50) = 45

tax for 2020 = ( 25% × 45 ) = 11.25

Hence, profit after tax for 2020 = (45 -11.25) = 33.75

Total sum of profit after tax from 2015 to 2020

⇒ ( 27.2 +36+39.1 +36.8 +33.75 +33.75)= 206.6

**The total sum of profit after tax = 206.6.**
